$comment: bipe-chat/bipe#733: the three roles of a group and the m.room.power_levels of a new group. Admin changes roles and group settings and notifies everyone with @room (#718). Moderador removes and bans members, deletes other people's messages and pins messages. Membro posts, reacts and replies. The app shows no numbers and no custom levels. A room whose levels another Matrix app changed keeps them: the members screen shows the nearest role and a note. The assistant notice chat.bipe.assistant stays open, as in DMs (bipe-chat/bipe#879). Old groups keep their power levels.
